body: MCM BRAND POSITION STATEMENT. What MCM is: a coaching tool not a tutoring app. Marcus is coach, UI is equipment, Kai is athlete. Three words: Direct Detroit Earned. DIRECT: every screen says one thing. No softening. Truth only. DETROIT: Bad Boys Pistons palette signals work and competition. Not decorative. EARNED: A-line turns green at 93% not before. Streak badge requires multiple days. Progress shows where you are not how hard you tried. What this excludes: pop gradients, soft rounded corners, below-A celebrations, 3+ font weights per screen, emoji as primary UI. How I use it: before adding any element I ask is this Direct Detroit Earned. No to any three means cut it.
